negativeControls.sourceContainerLoss: Normal rollback deliberately fails under injected external source removal. Same session survives connected inert containment and explicit source recovery; no product recovery UI.
negativeControls.unsupported: Unqualified tools, outside-owner overlays, iframe/media/canvas/native editors, nested applications, affected native and workspace interchange operations reject transfer.

limitations: No product source-tab reconciliation or session-aware Flint navigation integration.
Existing native destination required for transferred Save; no transferred first Save As UI.
No general tool promotion; only explicitly qualified portal adapters can follow.
No Desktop 5 persistence; capture and non-desktop switching reject live experimental topology.
Composition events synthetic; no operating-system IME, Safari or Firefox qualification.
Native Save responses stubbed in memory; no production filesystem writes.
Headless browser evidence is functional interaction evidence, not user-visible latency measurement.
environmentalAttempts: Earlier concurrent attempts encountered ENOSPC during collection. Final targeted and regression unit runs used one worker and completed.
